text:
invoice-bot: New invoice uploaded: Sunridge Supplies INV-9876 | Amount: $12,450 | No PO attached | Early-pay: 2% if paid within 10 days | PDF: https://redwood.app/invoices/INV-9876.pdf
Maya K: Noticed this. No PO on record for INV-9876. Who requested?
Jonah (Ops): I saw the expense hit the events request queue. Looks like it was for the monthly events kit restock but amount is higher than the usual ~$4-5k.
Lex R: Quick vendor/PO match returned PO-3012-FF for $9k last year — not the same. No standing PO found.
Nate D: @Sophie P can AP check vendor master and approver chain?
Sophie P: Vendor exists in masterfile as Sunridge Supplies (vendor id VS-442). They don't have a blanket PO. For invoices >$5k we need a PO or documented finance exception + approver.
Maya K: Right. 2% is about $249. Might be worth capturing if we can get a retro PO fast. But Procurement lead Aisha is OOO today.
Jonah (Ops): Can Procurement issue a retro PO while Aisha's out? What's the fallback?
Aisha (Procurement): I'm on mobile — if this is time-sensitive, Procurement backup can approve a retro PO up to $25k with manager approval. Who's the owning cost center?
Lex R: Cost center should be ENG-DEVINFRA (ENG-DI). The original request came through the Dedicated Infra ticket.
Maya K: Good. Sophie, can AP request a due-date extension while we get the PO?
Sophie P: Yes. I'll email Sunridge today with our extension template asking to extend to 30 days or accept a retro PO if we supply it within 5 business days. Also flaging the invoice in NetSuite as PO-MISSING/AWAITING-APPROVAL.
invoice-bot: Invoice INV-9876 flagged: hold_code=PO-MISSING, status=on-hold.
Jonah (Ops): Drafting a retro PO now to speed things — pasting draft: ```
PO DRAFT:
Vendor: Sunridge Supplies
Invoice: INV-9876
Amount: $12,450
Cost center: ENG-DEVINFRA (ENG-DI)
Approver: Procurement backup (manager approval)
Notes: Retro PO for event supplies; one-off. Invoice attached for reconciliation.
```
Maya K: Thanks Jonah. Sophie, can you attach that draft when you request extension? Also mention the early-pay discount so vendor knows we intend to pay promptly.
Sophie P: Done. Email sent to ap@sunridge.com and cc procurement@redwood.com. Asked for confirmation and requested vendor remittance slip.
Nate D: If vendor won't extend, what's the manual override path? Can we provisionally authorize payment to capture the 2%?
Aisha (Procurement): Procurement backup confirmed they can approve retro PO if Eng manager signs off. Manager is Lex R. Lex, can you sign or confirm?
Lex R: I can approve the cost center charge. I'll sign the approval form and notify Procurement backup.
Maya K: Solid. Sophie, update NetSuite status to AWAITING-PO and set reminder for 5 business days.
Sophie P: Done. Reminder set. Vendor replied: "We can extend to 30 days if Redwood issues a PO within 5 business days." Attached remittance confirmation.
Maya K: Great — vendor will accept retro PO. Jonah, please forward the PO draft to Procurement backup for issuance.
Jonah (Ops): Forwarded. Procurement backup sent a provisional PO number: PO-2026-R (provisional) pending final entry when Aisha returns.
invoice-bot: PO attached to invoice INV-9876: PO-2026-R (status: provisional).
Maya K: I'll log this in the finance tracker and mark as eligible for early-pay once final PO posts. Sophie — once the PO converts from provisional to final, can AP schedule payment capturing the 2%?
Sophie P: Yes. We'll hold until PO finalization then submit payment within discount window. If PO finalization misses the 10-day window, we'll evaluate provisional payment with Procurement sign-off to still capture discount.
Lex R: I've signed the manager approval form and sent to Procurement backup.
Maya K: Thanks everyone. Moving this thread to "awaiting PO finalization." Will update when payment scheduled. :white_check_mark:
